radius.simple.title: RADIUS / AAA
radius.simple.subtitle: Device administration with reusable permission profiles and NAS-scoped access.
radius.simple.name: Name
radius.simple.sourceHint: Single IP such as 10.10.10.5 or a network such as 10.10.10.0/24
radius.simple.secretEdit: Shared Secret (leave blank to keep current)
radius.simple.noSecrets: Secrets and passwords are never shown again after saving.
radius.simple.noAutoPush: EMS does not push configuration to network devices.
radius.simple.requiresGroup: Create a permission profile and NAS Collection first.
radius.simple.advancedNote: MAB / 802.1X policies are managed separately under 802.1X / MAC.
radius.simple.secretHint: Any non-empty safe ASCII secret; 20+ characters recommended
radius.simple.mikrotikGroupHint: Choose a RouterOS default group or select Custom for a group you created on the router.
radius.simple.ciscoHelp0: 0 — Minimal access; normally only a very small command set such as logout/help.
radius.simple.ciscoHelp1: 1 — User EXEC; the normal low-privilege login level.
radius.simple.ciscoHelp2to14: 2–14 — Custom intermediate levels. Cisco does not define fixed permissions for these levels; access depends on commands assigned on the device.
radius.simple.ciscoHelp15: 15 — Privileged EXEC / full administrative level by default.
radius.simple.ciscoHelpNote: RADIUS returns shell:priv-lvl=N. The Cisco device ultimately enforces which commands that level may run.
radius.simple.mikrotikCustomHint: Enter an existing RouterOS group name
radius.simple.collectionMembersHint: One exact IPv4 or CIDR per line. 0.0.0.0/0 covers every registered NAS unless a more specific collection rule matches.
radius.simple.accessRulesHint: Select the NAS collections this user may access, then choose the permission profile for each.
radius.simple.noCollections: Create a NAS Collection before granting device access.
radius.simple.requiresCollection: Create a NAS Collection before creating an enabled device-admin user.
radius.simple.requiresAccess: An enabled user needs at least one NAS Collection and permission profile.
radius.simple.liveVolatileHint: Live only — this console buffer is not stored in the EMS database.
radius.simple.liveFilter: Filter user, NAS, IP or client…
radius.simple.secretProfilesHint: Reusable RADIUS client secrets. Secret values are write-only.
radius.simple.secretProfileHint: The NAS uses this shared secret. Overlapping CIDRs use the most-specific NAS definition.
radius.simple.passwordWeakWarning: Passwords shorter than 12 characters are allowed, but are considered weak.
radius.simple.secretWeakWarning: Shared secrets shorter than 20 characters are allowed, but are considered weak.
radius.simple.diagnosticsHint: Checks the database, FreeRADIUS process, UDP listeners and live-log collector.
